quotes.text: What is your understanding of the risk to our NC3 cryptographic capabilities given the rapid advances in quantum and artificial intelligence? What are the priority actions necessary to ensure our NC3 enterprise network remains secure and impervious to these evolving threats?

CJADC2 [Combined Joint All Domain Command and Control] and AI [artificial intelligence] I know is growing importance for your air defense command and control. Could you talk a little bit about the importance of the Maven Smart System?
This bill also requires the Department to review, update, and modernize its policies on leveraging AI for military functions, ensuring more secure and robust development of AI capabilities.
